the development of new technologies for big data analysis that are able to cope with the requirements of personalized medicine.
the development of a novel approach for the analysis of big data in the field of personalized healthcare.
the application of big data analytics to personalized healthcare.

big data technologies can be used to improve the quality of life of individual patients, by providing personalized healthcare solutions that are robust, effective and affordable.

the big data analytics can help in the development of the in silico medicine, and the in silico models can help in the analysis of big data.

big data technologies can be successfully combined and extended with VPH technologies for the development of effective in silico personalized healthcare solutions.
